passage: The neighborhood library will open two hours earlier on Saturdays beginning September 5 after a survey showed strong demand from families. To fund the change without adding staff, Tuesday closing time will move from 8 p.m. to 6 p.m. Weekday morning hours and all Sunday hours remain unchanged. The library will review attendance after three months.

keyPoints.text: The library will open two hours earlier on Saturdays starting September 5.
Tuesday closing moves from 8 p.m. to 6 p.m. to fund the change without more staff.
Attendance will be reviewed after three months.

referenceAnswer: The library will open earlier Saturdays and close earlier Tuesdays starting September 5, then review attendance after three months.
